title: Promo writer (brasil)
description:
Empresa está contratando Promo writer (brasil) em remote. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Promo Writer    Location: Remote    Position Type: Contract    Company: Pocket FM    About Us    At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series.    Role Overview    As a Promo Writer, you will be responsible for creating high-impact promotional scripts for Pocket FM audio series. These promo scripts will be used for performance marketing campaigns across various platforms, including Meta and UAC, and will later be moved into post-production for final execution.    The role requires a strong understanding of ad creation, trailer writing, promo structuring, storytelling hooks, audience retention, emotional pacing, and localized content adaptation. You will write fresh promotional ads from scratch, adapt existing ads from the English team into Brazilian Portuguese, localize them for the target audience, and refine existing ads to improve quality and performance.    You will work closely with creative, editorial, production, and performance marketing teams to deliver production-ready promo scripts and suggest rework hypotheses for non-performing ads.      Key Responsibilities     1. Promo, Trailer & Ad Script Writing Write fresh promotional ad scripts from scratch for Pocket FM audio series. Create engaging long-form promo scripts, typically ranging from 30 to 60 minutes, designed to drive listener interest and campaign performance. Develop strong hooks, emotional beats, cliffhangers, character moments, and narrative setups that make the audience want to start listening to the series. Write scripts that are clear, engaging, and suitable for audio-first post-production. Ensure each promo script reflects the core promise, genre, tone, and audience appeal of the series. 2. Adaptation & Localization Adapt promotional scripts and ad concepts shared by the English team into Brazilian Portuguese. Localize scripts culturally and emotionally so they feel natural and relevant for the Brazilian audience. Maintain the original creative intent while improving clarity, relatability, and audience engagement for the local market. Ensure adapted ads do not feel like direct translations, but like native, market-ready promotional scripts. 3. Script Refinement & Quality Improvement Review and refine existing promo scripts to improve overall storytelling quality, pacing, emotional impact, and clarity. Strengthen weak openings, hooks, transitions, character motivations, and call-to-action moments. Improve scripts based on editorial feedback, performance insights, and creative direction. Ensure all final scripts are polished, coherent, and aligned with Pocket FM’s creative and quality standards. 4. Production-Ready Script Delivery Create production-ready promo scripts with clear structure, scene flow, dialogue, narration, emotional cues, and production notes wherever required. Ensure scripts are easy for voice-over artists, editors, and post-production teams to understand and execute. Provide clear direction on tone, pauses, dramatic moments, sound cues, and emotional delivery where needed. Support the production team by ensuring the script intent is preserved during execution. 5. Performance Reworks & Creative Hypotheses Analyze non-performing ads and suggest creative hypotheses for improvement. Recommend reworks based on possible issues such as weak hooks, unclear story setup, low emotional impact, poor pacing, or ineffective localization. Create alternate openings, revised structures, stronger cliffhangers, and improved audience entry points for underperforming promos. Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to test different ad angles and improve campaign performance. 6. Creative & Editorial Collaboration Work closely with editorial, production, localization, and performance marketing teams. Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revised scripts within timelines. Maintain consistency in character, tone, story logic, and emotional continuity across promo assets. Contribute ideas for new promo formats, trailer structures, and ad angles that can improve audience response. 7. AI Tool Usage & Workflow Optimization Use Gen AI and writing tools where required to support ideation, adaptation, translation review, and script refinement. Apply strong human editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets narrative, cultural, and quality standards. Review AI-generated outputs for tone, accuracy, cultural relevance, and storytelling strength. Use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality without compromising creative originality.      Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, Journalism, Film, or a related field. Strong writing and storytelling skills, especially for audio, ads, trailers, promos, or digital content. Excellent command of Brazilian Portuguese, with strong understanding of local cultural nuances, expressions, and audience preferences. Good understanding of English, with the ability to adapt English scripts and concepts into natural Brazilian Portuguese. Strong sense of narrative structure, emotional pacing, character motivation, hooks, and cliffhangers. Experience in promo writing, ad scriptwriting, trailer writing, fiction writing, audio storytelling, content localization, or digital performance creatives is preferred. Ability to write production-ready scripts with clear directions for voice-over and post-production teams. Ability to analyze feedback and performance signals to improve creative output. Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain quality across multiple deliverables. Comfortable working in a fast-paced content and performance marketing environment. Familiarity with AI-based writing, translation, or content adaptation tools is a plus.      Ideal Candidate    The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller who understands how to turn an audio series into a compelling promotional experience. They should know how to grab attention quickly, build emotional curiosity, create drama, and write scripts that make audiences want to listen further.    They should be equally comfortable writing original promo scripts, adapting English ads into Brazilian Portuguese, refining existing scripts, and suggesting creative reworks for ads that are not performing well.

Role Overview    We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.    The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.      Key Responsibilities    Business Development & Partnerships Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered) Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)    Market & Network Development Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa) Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape    Execution & Collaboration Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships    Banking & Infrastructure Setup Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement    Requirements 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM    Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. Translate business needs into clear, complete, and actionable business and functional requirements. Facilitate structured walkthroughs and reviews of requirements with business stakeholders and project team members. Work with business and technology teams to clarify requirements, resolve questions, and maintain alignment throughout the project lifecycle. Evaluate business requests to determine scope, feasibility, dependencies, risks, and potential solution options. Support projects involving data, reporting, business intelligence, data warehousing, or information management. Work with business stakeholders to define reporting needs, business rules, data definitions, and expected outcomes. Assist business and technology teams in identifying data-related issues and documenting potential solutions. Support the development and refinement of project backlogs, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Participate in project planning, sprint planning, backlog refinement, demonstrations, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies. Support user acceptance testing by developing test scenarios, coordinating business participation, documenting results, and tracking issues through resolution. Assist with change management, implementation planning, troubleshooting, and post-production support activities. Proactively identify opportunities to improve business processes, project delivery, service quality, and operational efficiency. Encourage collaboration and help establish a shared understanding of evolving business requirements and project needs. Communicate project updates, risks, decisions, dependencies, and outstanding issues to appropriate stakeholders. Manage multiple assignments, priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines in a changing project environment. Maintain regular and predictable attendance. Perform other duties as assigned.  Job Specifications    Education and Experience      Required Education and Experience Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience. Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, IT Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or Technical Business Analyst. Experience gathering, analyzing, documenting, and managing business and functional requirements. Experience working with business stakeholders and technology teams. Experience creating user stories, acceptance criteria, process documentation, and business requirements. Experience working in an Agile, Scrum, or similar environment.    Preferred Experience supporting data teams or working on data-related projects. Experience with data warehousing, reporting, analytics, business intelligence, data integration, or data management initiatives. General familiarity with structured data, data quality, reporting requirements, and business rules. Experience with reporting or business intelligence tools such as Tableau or Business Objects. Experience with data modeling tools such as Erwin. Insurance or financial services industry experience. Six Sigma certification or process-improvement experience.    Skills and Abilities    Required Strong business analysis, requirements-gathering, and documentation skills. Ability to understand business processes and translate business needs into viable technology solutions. Ability to work effectively with both business and technical stakeholders. General understanding of technology projects, systems, data flows, integrations, reporting, and software delivery processes. Ability to facilitate meetings, requirements sessions, workshops, and cross-functional discussions. Strong interpersonal and relationship-management skills. Strong investigative, analytical, and problem-solving abilities. Strong oral and written communication skills. Ability to explain business requirements and technology concepts to audiences with different levels of technical knowledge. Ability to create clear user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional documentation. Detail orientation and the ability to deliver accurate, high-quality work. Ability to work effectively within an Agile team environment. Ability to organize and manage multiple tasks, clients, projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously. Ability to quickly adapt to new processes, systems, teams, and methods. Ability to work through ambiguity and evolving requirements. Ability to appropriately balance priorities, deadlines, risks, and project deliverables.    Technical Expectations    The Senior IT Business Analyst should be comfortable working in a technology environment and collaborating with developers, data engineers, architects, quality assurance professionals, and reporting teams. The position does not require the individual to be a developer, data engineer, or advanced technical specialist.    Basic familiarity with SQL, databases, reporting systems, data warehousing, or data analysis is beneficial, but the primary emphasis of the role is business analysis, stakeholder communication, requirements management, process understanding, and successful project delivery.

Role purpose    Support i QIYI’s expansion in Brazil and Latin America by prospecting, developing and coordinating commercial and marketing partnerships. The role requires the ability to independently organize priorities, lead meetings, prepare proposals, follow up on opportunities and coordinate projects with external partners and internal teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia, without constant supervision.      Key responsibilities   1. Business Development & Partnerships – approximately 70% Map, prospect and develop relationships with private and public free-to-air broadcasters, telecommunications operators, digital and OTT platforms, distributors, technology companies, payment providers, retailers, consumer brands and other strategic partners. Build and maintain an organized pipeline of potential partners in Brazil and other Latin American markets, documenting contacts, opportunity stages, next steps, risks and timelines. Prepare presentations, commercial proposals, preliminary partnership models, meeting minutes, progress reports and decision-support materials. Lead initial meetings, identify partner needs and develop value propositions suited to different cooperation models. Support negotiations involving content distribution, licensing, revenue sharing, subscription bundles, media/barter, co-marketing, customer benefits, promotions and other commercial models. Negotiate commercial terms within approved parameters and coordinate validation with the Country Manager and relevant i QIYI functions; final approvals and signatures remain with management and headquarters. Coordinate the progress of opportunities with internal content, marketing, product, technology, legal, finance, operations and other teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia. Support partnership implementation after approval, ensuring alignment on scope, deliverables, timelines and performance indicators. Conduct research on markets, competitors, potential partners and trends across streaming, television, telecommunications and entertainment in Latin America. Represent i QIYI in partner meetings, industry events and business visits, with availability for occasional travel within Brazil and Latin America. 2. Marketing Partnerships – approximately 30% Identify and structure marketing opportunities with commercial partners to promote the i QIYI brand, priority content launches and subscription offers. Plan and coordinate co-marketing initiatives, partner campaigns, events, activations, content promotion and online/offline promotional projects. Adapt global briefs and materials to the needs of Brazil and other Latin American markets, ensuring local relevance and compliance with brand guidelines. Coordinate deliverables with internal and external stakeholders, including partners, agencies, public relations teams, influencers and vendors when applicable. Track execution and results, gather evidence of delivery and prepare reports with learnings and recommendations.      Required qualifications At least 3 years of experience in business development, partnerships, commercial roles, partnership marketing or related functions. Hands-on experience in B2 B prospecting, relationship management, proposal preparation and follow-up of negotiations or partner projects. Fluent or native Portuguese. Professional English, with the ability to participate in meetings, prepare presentations and communicate with international teams. Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, set priorities, meet deadlines and keep stakeholders informed. Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, organization and relationship-building skills. Availability to collaborate across time zones and travel occasionally within Brazil and Latin America. Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, International Relations, Economics or a related field. Proficiency in Power Point/Google Slides and Excel/Google Sheets; familiarity with CRM and project-management tools is preferred.    Preferred qualifications Experience in streaming, entertainment, television, media, telecommunications, technology or digital platforms. Professional Spanish for communication with partners across Latin America. Existing relationships with broadcasters, telecom operators, platforms, agencies, brands or other potential partners. Experience working in multicultural environments and with international headquarters or regional teams. Knowledge of licensing, revenue-share, subscription bundles, co-marketing and media/barter models. Mandarin Chinese. Experience working with Chinese companies and a strong understanding of Chinese corporate culture will be considered a distinct advantage.    Employment conditions and benefits Permanent CLT employment agreement. Initially remote work, with the possibility that the work model may be reviewed in the future, including hybrid or office-based arrangements, in accordance with business needs, company policy and applicable law. Quarterly bonus in accordance with company policy and individual/corporate performance. Health insurance plan, meal/food allowance and life insurance. 30 calendar days of paid annual leave, 13th-month salary, FGTS, INSS and other statutory benefits under Brazilian law. Applicable statutory leave and occupational health examinations.

title: Analista de planejamento (projetos) sênior
description:

Sobre a Gruen      Fundada no Brasil em 2020, com sede em São Paulo, a Gruen conta com um time de engenharia atuando tanto localmente quanto na Alemanha o que assegura o desenvolvimento do processo mais eficiente para cada projeto. Nossa missão é entregar a melhor tecnologia para purificação de biogás com o menor consumo de energia entre todos os processos disponíveis no mercado.    Nossas soluções são específicas e feitas sob medida de acordo com a necessidade dos nossos clientes: pré-tratamento do gás, remoção de CO2 e N2, optional CO2 capture and storage ou liquefação, Liquefação de CH4 ou compressão de 250bar – desde o projeto inicial até a gestão da operação da planta, garantindo satisfação total de nossos clientes.    Fabricação e assistência técnica locais resultam em redução de custo e aumento de eficiência.    Soluções para contratos de manutenção e operação das plantas viabilizam a redução da complexidade e de custos.    Nossa motivação é desenvolver soluções viáveis na geração de energia limpa e sustentável para a preservação do nosso planeta e das gerações futuras.      Objetivo do Cargo: Garantir o planejamento eficiente e o acompanhamento detalhado de projetos de engenharia, assegurando que sejam executados dentro dos prazos, custos e padrões de qualidade estabelecidos. Será responsável por elaborar cronogramas, alocar recursos, monitorar o progresso dos projetos e mitigar riscos, visando a otimização de processos e a maximização da eficiência. Além disso, deve fornecer suporte estratégico para a alta gestão, por meio de relatórios e análises de desempenho, contribuindo para a tomada de decisões e a realização bem-sucedida dos projetos.      Atribuições: Desenvolver planos de execução, cronogramas e alocação de recursos para garantir prazos e qualidade. Monitorar o progresso do projeto, identificar riscos e desvios, e realizar ajustes quando necessário. Elaborar orçamentos, controlar custos e realizar análises financeiras para garantir a viabilidade dos projetos. Gerar relatórios de progresso, indicadores e dados para a diretoria. Identificar e mitigar riscos durante a execução dos projetos. Trabalhar com as equipes multidisciplinares para garantir o cumprimento de prazos e qualidade. Implementar melhorias nos processos de planejamento e execução, visando otimizar custos e tempo. Apoiar na elaboração e monitoramento de contratos, garantindo o cumprimento de prazos.    Requisitos: Graduação em Engenharia Engenharia Civil, Elétrica, Mecânica, de Produção ou áreas correlatas). Certificações em ferramentas de planejamento de projetos, como MS Project, ou outras plataformas de gestão de projetos. Conhecimento sólido em Power BI Certificação PMP    Benefícios Regime de contrato CLT. Salário competitivo ao do mercado. Vale transporte. Vale refeição(Flash). Plano de saúde. A dynamic, elite culture where you are selling a product with unrivaled market    validation and massive financial runway.

title: Pesquisador doutor - comercial agrícola anhumaí - segurança microbiológica na cadeia do amido - doutores inovando no setor empresarial | iel/pr
description:
Confira a vaga para Pesquisador doutor - comercial agrícola anhumaí - segurança microbiológica na cadeia do amido - doutores inovando no setor empresarial | iel/pr em tamboara. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.    O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.    Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .      Sobre a Oportunidade:    A Comercial Agrícola Anhumaí Ltda atua na cadeia produtiva do amido de mandioca, com foco na qualidade, segurança e conformidade do produto final. Em um setor que exige controle rigoroso, a empresa busca aprimorar seus processos para reduzir riscos microbiológicos e atender aos limites estabelecidos pela legislação vigente.    Neste projeto, a atuação será voltada à avaliação de fontes de contaminação por Bacillus cereus, analisando dados desde a matéria-prima no campo até o produto final estocado. O objetivo é identificar pontos críticos e desenvolver estratégias de controle que fortaleçam a segurança e a qualidade do amido de mandioca.    Se você tem perfil analítico, interesse em microbiologia, qualidade e segurança de alimentos, essa é uma oportunidade para contribuir com melhorias técnicas e gerar impacto direto na cadeia produtiva.      Projeto:    Avaliação de fontes de contaminação microbiológica e desenvolvimento de estratégias de controle de Bacillus Cereus em amidos de mandioca.        Formação Acadêmica: Doutorado em Microbiologia, Ciência de Alimentos, Engenharia de Alimentos, Engenharia Química, Biotecnologia, Bioquímica ou áreas correlatas .      Principais Atividades: Relatórios técnicos periódicos; Protocolos de monitoramento e controle microbiológico; Pareceres técnicos; Procedimentos operacionais para mitigação da contaminação por Bacillus cereus ; Relatório final consolidado do projeto. Monitoramento microbiológico do processo produtivo.    Requisitos Técnicos Mínimos: Conhecimento em microbiologia de alimentos; Métodos de análise microbiológica e interpretação de resultados; Análise de dados aplicada ao monitoramento microbiológico.    Requisitos Técnicos Desejáveis / Diferenciais: Conhecimento sobre Bacillus cereus ; Ferramentas de qualidade e melhoria contínua, como APPCC e ciclo PDCA; Desejável conhecimento em legislação sanitária aplicável a alimentos; Conhecimento do processo de produção de amido de mandioca ou processos correlacionados.    Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial    Formato de trabalho : Presencial / Tamboara - PR      Soft Skills : Trabalho em equipe, Pensamento crítico, Proatividade e organização.

title: Client success manager (smma)
description:
Confira a vaga para Client success manager (smma) em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Client Success Manager — 2 URN Marketing      Location: Remote Type: Full-time Reports to: COO Comp: $2,000 + $ bonuses tied to retention & client results and revneu share (3% of renewals + 10% Upsells)      Read this part first    Most agencies hand a roofer a login and a monthly report and call it service. We don't do that. We come into roofing companies internally and build — the funnel, the CRM, the follow-up, the reporting, the process their office actually runs on. Our clients don't buy leads from us. They buy a lead engine we install and then operate alongside their team.    That means this is not a check-in-and-take-notes job. You are the person inside the client's business making the machine work. If you like owning outcomes and hate babysitting inboxes, keep reading.      What you'll actually own    You'll carry a book of roofing contractor accounts from signed contract through their entire life with us.    Launch (first 24–72 hours after a client signs)   Run the onboarding call and pull everything the build needs: service area, offer, pricing, photos, reviews, brand assets, calendar availability. Stand up their Go High Level sub-account: pipeline, calendar, lead-intake workflows, SMS + email follow-up, call routing. Get their landing page live and their form wired to the CRM — then test it yourself by submitting a real lead and watching it land. Confirm tracking fires end to end before a dollar of ad spend goes out.  We launch clients in days, not weeks. That deadline is yours to hold.    Ongoing (where the job really lives)   Watch every account's numbers daily: leads, cost per lead, show rate, booked inspections, closed jobs. Know which of your accounts is drifting before the client does. Run weekly and monthly client calls. Walk them through what's working, what isn't, and what you're changing — in plain English, not ad-platform jargon. Be the bridge to the media buyer and creative team. When CPL climbs or leads stop booking, you diagnose whether it's ads, the offer, the follow-up, or the client's own sales process — and you route it to the right person with the data attached. Coach the client's office staff on speed-to-lead and follow-up. Half of a bad month is a roofer who isn't calling leads back in five minutes. Your job is to say that out loud, kindly, with the call logs to prove it. Keep every account's notes, action items, and next steps current in the CRM and in Click Up. If it isn't written down, it didn't happen. Spot expansion honestly: more markets, more spend, add-on programs — but only when the core engine is already producing.  Retention   Own renewal and churn risk for your book. You should know which client is unhappy two weeks before they tell you. Run save conversations yourself. Bring the numbers, own what we got wrong, and come with a fix, not an apology.  What we measure you on   Client retention and length of stay On-time launches (live inside the promised window) Account health: leads delivered, CPL against target, show rate, booked jobs Speed of response to client issues CRM/Click Up hygiene — notes, action items, and reporting actually current  Who this is for   2+ years in account management, client success, or agency service — or you've run operations inside a home-services company and know the trade from inside. Comfortable in a CRM every single day. We run Go High Level — if you know it, say so loudly in your application. If you don't, you need to be the kind of person who'll learn a platform cold in two weeks. You can read an ad account report and tell a story with it. You don't need to be a media buyer, but you must know what cost per lead, show rate, and cost per booked job mean and what makes each one move. Direct communicator. Our clients are roofing owners and GMs. They want straight answers, not marketing vocabulary. Organized without being reminded. You'll juggle a dozen accounts, each with its own build state, spend level, and open items. Thick skin and a spine. Sometimes the honest answer is "your team isn't calling the leads." You have to be able to say it.  Bonus points for: home services / roofing / construction background, Meta Ads Manager familiarity, funnel building, Click Up, experience owning a renewal number.      What you get   A real book of business and the authority to actually fix things, not just escalate them. Direct access to the founder and the build team — no layers. A company that already has the delivery figured out: 26+ roofing clients served and 14,676 leads generated to date, backed by a 100,000-dollars-in- signed-jobs-in-90-days guarantee. You're not selling a promise; you're operating something that works. Unlimited PTO / Learning Oppertunities

OPERADOR DE E-COMMERCE | JÚ NIOR      A Plena Performance está apoiando uma empresa do segmento de varejo têxtil (cama, mesa e banho) na contratação de um(a) Operador(a) de E-commerce.      SOBRE A OPORTUNIDADE      A posição integra a operação de e-commerce de uma empresa do segmento de cama, mesa e banho, com atuação tanto em loja virtual própria quanto em marketplaces. O profissional será responsável por garantir a eficiência da operação digital — do cadastro de produtos ao atendimento ao cliente — contribuindo diretamente para a experiência de compra e os resultados das vendas online.      PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES      Receber, conferir e processar pedidos provenientes do site e dos principais marketplaces    Cadastrar e atualizar produtos com informações completas: medidas, composição, cores e imagens    Controlar estoque e disponibilidade dos produtos nas plataformas    Emitir notas fiscais e etiquetas de envio, acompanhando os pedidos até a entrega ao cliente    Realizar a separação de pedidos e garantir o cumprimento dos prazos de envio    Atender clientes via Whats App, chat, e-mail e telefone, esclarecendo dúvidas sobre produtos, prazos e trocas    Apoiar ações promocionais e campanhas de vendas online    Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho do e-commerce e propor melhorias operacionais      REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓ RIOS      Ensino médio completo    Experiência em e-commerce, atendimento ao cliente ou expedição de pedidos    Conhecimento básico do Pacote Office, com ênfase em Excel    Boa comunicação, organização e atenção aos detalhes    Facilidade para aprender e operar novos sistemas      DIFERENCIAIS      Curso técnico ou superior em andamento nas áreas de Administração, Logística, Marketing ou correlatas    Familiaridade com plataformas de marketplaces como Mercado Livre, Shopee, Amazon e Magalu    Experiência no segmento de cama, mesa e banho, decoração ou varejo têxtil    Conhecimento de ERPs e plataformas como Tray, Shopify, Nuvemshop, Bling, Tiny ou similares    Noções de fotografia de produtos e criação de anúncios      INFORMAÇÕ ES DA VAGA      Cargo: Operador de E-commerce    Segmento: Varejo têxtil — Cama, Mesa e Banho    Regime de contratação: A confirmar com o cliente    Remuneração: Compatível com o mercado    Benefícios: Pacote de benefícios atrativo      ETAPAS DO PROCESSO      Cadastro completo na plataforma    Preenchimento da avaliação comportamental DISC    Triagem e análise de aderência ao perfil    Etapas de validação técnica e alinhamento com o cliente      INFORMAÇÕ ES IMPORTANTES      As informações desta vaga são mantidas sob sigilo e os dados dos candidatos serão tratados conforme a LGPD. O processo seletivo poderá envolver etapas de validação técnica e alinhamento com o cliente.      COMO SE CANDIDATAR      Para participar do processo seletivo, é necessário realizar seu cadastro completo na plataforma.      Inclua seu currículo e as informações referentes ao seu perfil    Preencha a avaliação comportamental DISC    Finalize clicando no botão de candidatura      IMPORTANTE      Toda a triagem será realizada exclusivamente pela plataforma, por isso é essencial concluir todas as etapas. Ao finalizar seu cadastro, você receberá em seu e-mail o resumo do seu relatório DISC, com seus principais pontos fortes e dicas práticas de desenvolvimento.      As atualizações sobre o andamento da vaga também serão enviadas para o seu e-mail de cadastro.      Se esta oportunidade está alinhada ao momento profissional que você busca, clique em Candidatar-se e participe do processo seletivo.

title: Supervisor de segurança empresarial (ribeirão preto e região)
description:

Buscamos um Supervisor de Segurança Empresarial para atuar no segmento de telecomunicações , garantindo a proteção de pessoas, ativos e infraestrutura crítica.    Essa posição será volante , com atuação em toda a região DDD 16 (Ribeirão Preto e entorno) , sendo responsável pela supervisão operacional dos serviços de segurança, gestão de riscos e suporte às operações de campo.      Conheça nossa história:      A nossa história começa em 1994, na Argentina, quando a GIF se estabeleceu como fornecedora estratégica para empresas. Na mesma época, houve uma expansão comercial significativa, que foi acompanhada por um aumento de casos de fraudes. Foi nesse momento que a assumimos a responsabilidade de garantir a segurança das empresas e entramos em ação. title: Data scientist
description:
Empresa está contratando Data scientist em remote. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Senior Data Scientist – Forecasting & Optimization    Location: Brazil    Work model: Remote within Brazil    Employment type: Contract/PJ    Start date: As soon as possible      About the Role    We are looking for a hands-on, business-oriented Senior Data Scientist with strong experience in forecasting, predictive modeling, and optimization .      This role is ideal for someone who enjoys using data to solve practical business problems and can move comfortably between predictive modeling, exploratory data analysis, SQL queries, Excel-based analyses, and urgent stakeholder requests.      The successful candidate will focus on delivering measurable business value through pragmatic analytical solutions. This is not a research-oriented or Gen AI-focused position. We are looking for someone who understands that the best solution is often the simplest approach that reliably answers the business need.      Key Responsibilities   Develop and implement forecasting and predictive models to support business planning and decision-making. Build demand forecasting and time-series solutions using Python and SQL. Develop optimization and product allocation models. Analyze supply chain, inventory, allocation, and demand-planning challenges. Conduct exploratory data analysis and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations. Respond to ad hoc analytical requests and urgent business questions. Extract, manipulate, and analyze data using SQL, Python, and Excel. Partner with business stakeholders to understand their needs and define practical analytical solutions. Communicate complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Balance longer-term analytical initiatives with immediate business priorities. Select the most effective tool or methodology for each problem, from spreadsheets and SQL queries to predictive and optimization models.    Required Qualifications   Proven professional experience as a Data Scientist or in a similar analytical role. Strong experience with forecasting, predictive analytics, and time-series modeling. Proficiency in Python and SQL. Advanced analytical skills using Excel. Experience developing optimization models or solving decision-science and operations-research problems. Strong exploratory data analysis and data interpretation skills. Ability to translate business questions into analytical approaches and actionable recommendations. Experience working directly with business stakeholders. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Ability to work independently, manage ambiguity, and prioritize competing requests. Must be based in Brazil and available to work remotely.    Preferred Qualifications   Experience supporting supply chain, inventory, product allocation, retail, or demand-planning teams. Experience building analytical solutions used in real business operations. Familiarity with production-level forecasting or optimization solutions. Experience working in fast-paced environments with changing priorities.    What Success Looks Like    You will succeed in this role if you can quickly understand business needs, work with available data, and deliver useful answers and solutions. You should be equally comfortable developing a forecasting model, investigating an unexpected business trend, writing SQL queries, creating an Excel analysis, or presenting recommendations to stakeholders.      We value practical problem-solving, flexibility, ownership, and business impact over unnecessary technical complexity.      Why Join Us?   Work remotely from anywhere in Brazil. Contribute to high-impact forecasting, optimization, and business analytics initiatives. Collaborate directly with business and technical stakeholders. Apply advanced analytical skills to practical, real-world decisions. Join a team that values adaptability, autonomy, and measurable results.

title: Director of strategic partnerships
description:

ABOUT ELIFE    Elife is the unified API infrastructure behind global mobility and instant delivery across 182 countries. We power Super Apps, Fin Techs, neobanks, and ride-hailing ecosystems worldwide — we don't compete with them, we enable them. Our partners integrate once and serve their users globally. We build and operate the infrastructure. Our partners own the brand and the customer relationship. We do not compete for our partners' users.      THE ROLE    We are looking for a proven ecosystem hunter — not an account manager, not a loyalty program builder, not a co-marketing specialist. Someone who has personally closed bidirectional commercial deals where both parties share live transaction revenue, through API integrations with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or mobility companies.    This is a greenfield, individual contributor role. You will build elife's LATAM pipeline from zero, own the full deal lifecycle from outreach to signed contract, and be expected to deliver active pipeline within the first 90 days.      WHAT YOU WILL DO Identify, engage and close strategic partnerships with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, ride-hailing operators and e-commerce ecosystems across LATAM Own the full commercial lifecycle — outreach, negotiation, deal structuring, contract execution and partner onboarding Structure and close revenue-share and API integration agreements where elife's infrastructure powers mobility and delivery services inside a partner's platform Build and maintain 20+ active enterprise prospects at any given time Engage C-suite and VP-level decision makers directly — no intermediaries Represent elife at industry events and forums across LATAM Report pipeline, forecasts and market intelligence directly to the VP of Partnerships    WHAT WE NEED — NON-NEGOTIABLE 8+ years of B2 B enterprise partnerships experience Minimum 3 years of direct experience closing ecosystem deals with or inside super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or ride-hailing companies in LATAM Proven track record closing bidirectional revenue-share deals — where revenue is generated by live transactions, not loyalty points, discount campaigns or co-marketing budgets Direct experience structuring and closing API integration partnerships commercially — owning the business case, commercial terms and deal execution end-to-end Active C-suite network verifiable with specific names in at least two of the following: Rappi, Uber, Di Di, Mercado Pago, Nu, Clip, Stori, Kavak, i Food or equivalent LATAM super apps or neobanks Multi-country LATAM experience — Mexico and/or Brazil required; Colombia, Argentina, Chile a plus Hunter DNA — you have built pipelines from zero, not inherited them Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese required; English proficiency required Bachelor's degree minimum; MBA strongly preferred    PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Prior experience working with or for mobility platforms, ride-hailing operators, corporate travel or fleet technology companies Track record closing first-of-kind or complex ecosystem partnerships with measurable commercial outcomes Experience managing partnerships across multiple LATAM countries simultaneously Familiarity with the regulatory and payments landscape across Brazil, Mexico and Colombia    WHAT WE OFFER Fixed monthly base + KPI bonus scalable up to 300% based on commercial results Uncapped commissions tied directly to the revenue you generate Remote-first with regional travel as required Direct access to C-suite and founder leadership from day one A genuinely entrepreneurial environment where your deals shape elife's growth trajectory in LATAM    MARKET CONTEXT    Latin America is one of the fastest-growing digital financial services markets in the world, led by Brazil and Mexico. The region is home to a dynamic ecosystem of super apps, neobanks, and ride-hailing operators actively seeking scalable mobility and delivery partnerships. The Director of Strategic Partnerships for LATAM will build elife's presence from the ground up in this high-potential, relationship-driven market — and earn accordingly.

title: Senior ai agent engineer
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior ai agent engineer em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About First Ignite    First Ignite makes software for university tech transfer offices. Those are the people who take research    coming out of a university lab and get it patented, licensed, or spun out into a company.      The role    We're hiring a Senior AI Agent Engineer. You'll build the agents in our product, and you'll build the    evals that tell us whether each change made them better or worse.    The work is document-heavy rather than chat. The agents run multi-step, call tools, read long and    inconsistently formatted source material, check it against existing records, and produce output that a    person reviews before anything happens with it.    Accuracy matters more here than speed or novelty. Most of the engineering effort goes into precision,    traceability, and getting the agent to hand off to a human at the right moment.    You'll report to the Head of Engineering and work with product and the full-stack team. If you've    shipped agents before, you've probably had the experience of changing a prompt and having no idea    whether you improved anything. That problem is most of this job.      What you'll do   • Design and ship long-running, multi-step, tool-using agents on various AI SDKs and tooling,    included but not limited to the Open AI Agents SDK, the Anthropic Agent SDK, the Vercel AI SDK,    Lang Graph, MCP, and Temporal Cloud.   • Wrap our APIs and our partners' APIs as tools an agent can call over MCP. Some of those systems    are old, single-tenant, and outside our control, so a fair amount of the work is translation.   • Get structured data out of long documents and match it against records that already exist. Expect    entity resolution and fuzzy matching, and expect much of it to run in batch.   • Stand up eval suites using various evaluation frameworks and tooling, included but not limited to    Promptfoo, Braintrust, Lang Smith, Deep Eval, LLM-as-judge methods, and custom harnesses.    Measure tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and whether the agent finished the task.   • Every agent here produces a draft that a person signs off on. Build the citations and confidence    signals that make that review fast, and give the agent a clear way to escalate.   • Sit with product and domain experts and turn vague quality goals into something measurable.    Sometimes the only dataset available for that is tiny, or confidential, or both.   • Instrument production traffic, turn real customer interactions into golden datasets, and run them as    regression tests.   • Compare models against each other (Open AI, Anthropic, open-weight), along with prompt    strategies and agent designs, and know what each option costs in latency and quality.   • Bootstrap quality signal for features that have no production traffic yet. That usually means    generating synthetic documents and test cases, including the ugly edge cases real customers will    eventually send us, and knowing where synthetic data stops being a good proxy.   • Write the templates, docs, and tooling the rest of the team needs to run evals without coming to    you.      Required Qualifications:   • 3+ years of engineering experience, including hands-on work on LLM or agent systems that real    users touched.   • You've evaluated agents, not only models, and you know why single-turn accuracy says little about    a multi-step run.   • You've integrated against APIs you don't own, including old ones with bad documentation, and    turned them into something an agent can call reliably.   • You're comfortable with document pipelines: pulling data out, normalizing it, and checking it against    a structured source of truth.   • You've used at least one LLM evaluation framework, in-house tooling included.   • You know how LLM-as-judge methods break down (position bias, verbosity bias, judge drift) and    what to do about it.   • You can tell a real regression from noise, and design an experiment that answers the question    being asked instead of a nearby one.   • You can read a customer call transcript, work out which failures matter, and ship a fix and an eval    for them.   • You write clearly. Engineers won't act on eval results they don't read or don't trust.   • You're based somewhere between New York time (ET) and Western European time. Italy is the    furthest east we can go.    You might currently be titled    AI Agent Engineer · Agentic AI Engineer · Senior AI Engineer · AI Systems Engineer · Lead AI    Developer · AI Solutions Architect · AI Integration Specialist · Senior Data Scientist, AI    Titles are all over the place in this space. If the work above matches what you already do, apply. We'll    go on what you've shipped.      Preferred Qualifications:   • You've evaluated retrieval systems: RAG, hybrid search, reranking.   • You've worked with agent orchestration frameworks like Temporal, Lang Graph, or the Open AI    Agents SDK, and you know how long-running tool use goes wrong.   • You have a background in information retrieval or search relevance.   • You've worked somewhere an agent's output carried financial or compliance consequences.   • You've built internal tooling that non-engineers used on their own to label and review model output.      This is a fully remote, full-time permanent position available to candidates located within the New York (ET) through Western Europe time zones, with flexible working hours to support collaboration across regions.

title: Qc analyst - audio content - brazil
description:
Empresa está contratando Qc analyst - audio content - brazil em remote. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Us      Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.      At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.      Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.      Role Overview      As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.      Key Responsibilities     1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.   2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.   3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble   4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.   Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.   5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.   6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.   7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.   8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology   9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.   10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement    Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to:   Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery    Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.      Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.      Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.      Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.    Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English    This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.      Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

Remote – Brazil | Full-Time | U. S. Market      Base Salary: $3,000–$3,500 USD/month + Uncapped Commission      Target OTE: $80,000–$100,000+ USD      We're Looking for A hunter.      This is not an Account Executive role where qualified meetings magically appear on your calendar.      There is no SDR handing you opportunities.      There is no list of warm leads waiting for you.      You will identify the accounts you want to win, find the decision-makers, get their attention, book the meeting, run the sales process, negotiate the deal, and close the business.      If building your own pipeline sounds exhausting, this probably isn't the role for you.      If you’ve built a career by creating opportunities other salespeople couldn't find and closing deals other salespeople couldn't close, keep reading.      What You'll Be Selling      Revenx helps financial professionals connect with public employees who are approaching important retirement decisions.      We're expanding our enterprise business and looking to build partnerships with IMOs, FMOs, large insurance agencies, financial services organizations, and other enterprise partners that can deploy our appointment programs across their organizations.      We're not looking for someone to sell individual agents.      We're looking for someone who can get in front of executives and decision-makers and close meaningful enterprise relationships.      You Own the Entire Sales Cycle      You will be responsible for:   Identifying and researching target enterprise accounts Building your own prospect lists and pipeline Cold calling executives and decision-makers Cold emailing Prospecting and connecting through Linked In Creating multi-touch outbound strategies to break into difficult accounts Setting your own appointments Running discovery calls Identifying organizational needs and buying opportunities Presenting our enterprise solutions Building proposals Navigating multiple stakeholders Handling objections Negotiating agreements Closing new enterprise business Handing signed accounts to Customer Success Going back out and finding the next one  Prospect. Book. Discover. Present. Negotiate. Close. Repeat.      What We're Looking For      We care far more about what you've actually done than what your previous title was.    You should have:   Proven success in B2 B sales Experience personally generating outbound pipeline Experience selling to executives, owners, or senior decision-makers Strong cold calling ability Strong written outbound prospecting skills Excellent spoken and written English Experience running discovery and closing your own opportunities Confidence negotiating larger contracts A history of consistently hitting or exceeding sales targets Strong CRM discipline The ability to operate independently without needing someone to tell you who to call next  Experience selling into financial services, insurance, Saa S, marketing services, lead generation, or other complex B2 B environments is a plus.      This Role is NOT For You If....      Your last company gave you most of your appointments.    You rely heavily on SDRs to build pipeline.    You consider sending a few Linked In messages "prospecting."    You are uncomfortable making cold calls.    You need a recognizable brand name to get meetings.    You are great at relationship management but don't love closing.    You want to inherit an existing book of business.    You are looking for an account management role.    This is a new-business hunter role.    What Success Looks Like      We are not hiring you to stay busy.    We're hiring you to generate new enterprise revenue.    You'll be measured primarily on:   Qualified enterprise pipeline created New enterprise opportunities generated New enterprise revenue closed New enterprise accounts acquired Quota attainment  Activity matters because activity creates pipeline.    But ultimately, you are here to close business.    Compensation      Base Salary: $3,000–$3,500 USD per month, depending on experience    On-Target Earnings: $80,000–$100,000+ USD annually    Commission: Uncapped    Exceptional performance should result in exceptional compensation. We do not want a commission structure that makes our best salesperson slow down after hitting quota.    The Person We're Looking For      You're resourceful.    You don't wait for leads.    You know how to get someone's attention when they've never heard of you.    You can speak comfortably with a salesperson one minute and an agency owner or executive the next.    You aren't intimidated by a difficult prospect.    You follow up relentlessly without becoming annoying.    You understand that "not interested" isn't always the end of a sales process.    Most importantly, you close.    If your strongest sales results came from opportunities you personally created, we'd like to talk to you. How to Apply:    Send your resume to careers@ and tell us:    What was the largest B2 B deal you personally sourced and closed?    Include:   How you originally found the account How you got the first meeting Approximate contract value Length of the sales cycle Your role in closing the deal    If most of your historical pipeline was generated by SDRs or inbound marketing, please be transparent about that.      We're specifically looking for someone who has proven they can create pipeline and close it.

Alguém que saiba ouvir, observar, compreender o contexto e identificar aquilo que precisa ser comunicado — com boa escrita, olhar jornalístico, sensibilidade institucional e compromisso com a informação de qualidade. title: Analista júnior de projetos de carbono
description:
Confira a vaga para Analista júnior de projetos de carbono em piracicaba. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Buscamos um profissional em início de carreira para apoiar o desenvolvimento, a estruturação técnica e o registro de projetos de carbono de alta integridade. Trata-se de um papel técnico e de suporte, com atuação acompanhada desde a concepção do projeto até sua submissão e registro junto a padrões reconhecidos.      Quem é a Plant?      A Plant Inteligência Ambiental integra um ecossistema de empresas em crescimento no mercado de projetos de carbono, com foco em soluções de alta integridade, especialmente em remoção de carbono (CDR), projetos REDD+ de elevada qualidade e abordagens inovadoras para posicionar a sustentabilidade como prioridade global. Atuando no mercado voluntário de carbono desde o Protocolo de Kyoto, em 1997, a empresa é especializada em soluções de gestão ambiental para os setores público e privado, com atuação em mercado de carbono, ESG e projetos florestais, agrícolas e industriais, combinando rigor técnico, base científica e desenvolvimento de projetos alinhados aos desafios climáticos atuais e futuros.      Analista Júnior em Desenvolvimento de Projetos de Carbono:    O escopo da posição abrange projetos de remoção e redução de emissões, com foco em:   Biochar como solução de remoção de carbono ARR (Aflorestamento, Reflorestamento e Revegetação) REDD+ Elaboração e revisão de inventários de emissões de gases de efeito estufa Desenvolvimento de projetos em sustentabilidade, impacto e clima  Esta posição é ideal para um perfil com boa base científica, vontade de aprender e interesse genuíno em metodologias, padrões e processos de registro de projetos de carbono.      Principais responsabilidades Apoio ao desenvolvimento de projetos de carbono, da fase conceitual ao registro, sob orientação de profissionais sênior Suporte à análise de elegibilidade e ao enquadramento metodológico Assistência técnica em projetos de biochar, ARR e REDD+ Apoio à elaboração e revisão da documentação técnica de projetos Acompanhamento das interações com padrões, registros, validadores e verificadores independentes Suporte em temas de adicionalidade, linha de base, MRV, permanência e riscos de reversão Auxílio no controle de qualidade científica e metodológica ao longo do ciclo do projeto    Requisitos da vaga Graduação concluída ou em fase final em áreas como sustentabilidade, ciências ambientais, agricultura, ciências florestais, engenharia ou áreas correlatas (pós-graduação em andamento é um diferencial, não um requisito) Até 2 anos de experiência — incluindo estágios, iniciação científica ou projetos acadêmicos — em desenvolvimento de projetos de carbono ou em funções correlatas e transferíveis, como LCA, inventários de GEE, projetos florestais ou agrícolas e sustentabilidade corporativa; não é necessário domínio prévio de padrões como Puro Earth e Verra, mas espera-se disposição para aprendê-los rapidamente Inglês intermediário a avançado, com capacidade de ler documentação técnica e evoluir para comunicação profissional com clientes e parceiros Desejável interesse ou noções em remoção de carbono, especialmente biochar e soluções baseadas na natureza Desejável familiaridade com sistemas de informação geográfica (SIG) e ou facilidade com cálculos e quantificação de emissões e remoções de GEE Desejável curiosidade por temas de project finance e viabilidade econômica de projetos de carbono    Habilidades interpessoais Capacidade de transitar entre fundamentos científicos e documentação técnica, com abertura para aprender Perfil organizado, atento a detalhes e proativo, com vontade de assumir responsabilidades crescentes ao longo do tempo Conforto para atuar em ambientes de projeto em estágio inicial ou de crescimento e para trabalhar em equipe com membros sênior

title: Desenvolvedor back-end java/kotlin - especialista
description:
Confira a vaga para Desenvolvedor back-end java/kotlin - especialista em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga    Somos responsáveis por construir e evoluir plataformas de engenharia que suportam soluções de IA em escala, atuando em camadas críticas de backend, BFFs e hubs de comunicação. Nosso foco está em arquiteturas resilientes, escaláveis e seguras, que sustentam produtos estratégicos e aceleram a adoção de IA no banco. Buscamos uma pessoa Especialista em Desenvolvimento Backend com foco em Kotlin , com forte maturidade técnica e capacidade de influenciar decisões arquiteturais de médio e longo prazo. Essa posição tem impacto direto na evolução das plataformas de AI Engineering e atua de forma transversal com diferentes times de tecnologia.      Responsabilidades e atribuições   • Liderar tecnicamente iniciativas complexas, atuando de ponta a ponta no ciclo de desenvolvimento de software, da concepção arquitetural ao deploy e operação em produção.   • Ser referência técnica para o time e para outras squads, garantindo padrões elevados de qualidade, performance, segurança e resiliência em serviços como BFFs, comm-hubs e APIs estratégicas.   • Definir e evoluir arquiteturas backend, avaliando trade-offs técnicos, riscos operacionais e impactos de longo prazo nas plataformas de AI Engineering.   • Estabelecer e disseminar boas práticas de engenharia, incluindo TDD/BDD, clean code, DDD, code reviews estruturados e alta cobertura de testes automatizados.   • Atuar fortemente na operação e sustentação dos sistemas em produção, com foco em observabilidade, análise de causa raiz, prevenção de incidentes e melhoria contínua.   • Influenciar decisões técnicas junto a produto, dados, plataforma e arquitetura, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas escaláveis e sustentáveis.   • Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico de engenheiros do time, promovendo evolução de competências e maturidade em engenharia de software.      Requisitos e qualificações   • Experiência avançada e comprovada em desenvolvimento backend com Kotlin ou Java, utilizando frameworks como Spring Boot em ambientes de alta escala.   • Forte domínio em arquitetura de microsserviços e BFFs, incluindo versionamento de APIs, padrões de integração, resiliência, escalabilidade e comunicação assíncrona.   • Experiência sólida com automação de testes em múltiplos níveis (unitários, integração, contrato), garantindo confiabilidade e segurança nas entregas.   • Conhecimento aprofundado em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, como Postgre SQL, Mongo DB e Cassandra, com foco em consistência, performance e disponibilidade.   • Vivência robusta com sistemas de mensageria e streaming, como Kafka, SQS e SNS, em cenários de alta volumetria.   • Domínio de práticas de observabilidade, incluindo métricas, logs estruturados, tracing distribuído e definição de SLIs/SLOs.   • Experiência prática em ambientes Cloud (preferencialmente AWS), com uso de infraestrutura como código (Terraform ou Cloud Formation) e pipelines de CI/CD maduros.   • Conhecimento avançado em segurança de aplicações, incluindo autenticação e autorização (JWT, OAuth2), criptografia e práticas de secure by design.   • Atuação consistente em ambientes ágeis, com mentalidade Dev Ops, ownership técnico e foco em eficiência operacional.   • Experiência prévia em plataformas complexas, integração entre sistemas ou produtos digitais de missão crítica.

Hoje, nossas quatro unidades agroindustriais, localizadas em Lençóis Paulista, Macatuba, Quatá e Lucélia, junto aos nossos escritórios administrativos em Lençóis Paulista e em São Paulo, nos posicionam como uma das maiores empresas do país no setor sucroenergético.    Por aqui, todas e todos são bem-vindos. Indicadores de Suprimentos e Logística. Análise financeira (TCO, Cost Breakdown e Should Cost). Pacote Office. SAP S/4 HANA (FIORI e Transportation).    Principais Responsabilidades Desenvolver e executar estratégias de compras para as categorias de logística, transportes (fretes dedicados e spot), combustíveis e lubrificantes. title: Executivo de vendas técnicas
description:
Nova oportunidade para Executivo de vendas técnicas em curitiba. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Sobre a Servicekleen    Imagine trabalhar em uma empresa onde sua função realmente importa para o planeta.    Somos a Servicekleen — uma líder mundial com mais de 50 anos de experiência em 15 países, apoiando empresas globais a manterem suas operações críticas mais seguras e mais limpas. Entregamos soluções de limpeza de peças que ajudam os clientes a reduzir o consumo de energia e a operar de forma mais responsável com o meio ambiente.    Suas ideias importam em uma cultura baseada em respeito e vitória conjunta.    Seu trabalho contribui diretamente para um planeta mais limpo.      E embora atuemos globalmente, a força real do nosso negócio vive em nossas filiais. Nossas pessoas são o coração da nossa missão.      Sobre a vaga    Nosso Executivo de Vendas é um cargo de campo com alta atividade voltado para novos negócios, focado em identificar, engajar e converter, predominantemente, clientes industriais de pequeno, médio e grande porte dentro de um território designado — ajudando os clientes a operar de forma mais segura, eficiente e responsável.    Você passará a maior parte do tempo em campo: convertendo leads quentes, prospectando de forma proativa, conduzindo reuniões estruturadas com clientes e avançando oportunidades por meio de um processo de vendas definido — do primeiro contato ao fechamento. O sucesso na função depende de prospecção disciplinada, execução de vendas estruturada com uma metodologia líder de mercado e da capacidade de articular claramente propostas técnicas e de valor.    Você construirá relacionamentos de trabalho presenciais sólidos em toda a rede Servicekleen, atuando em estreita colaboração presencial com as equipes de filial e de suporte para garantir comunicação clara, trabalho integrado e um serviço consistentemente forte para os clientes.    Sua missão: construir um pipeline sólido de novos clientes, conquistar novos negócios de forma consistente e representar a Servicekleen com profissionalismo e integridade — ajudando a tornar nosso planeta mais seguro e mais limpo, ao mesmo tempo em que oferece tranquilidade aos clientes.      Quais serão suas atividades   • Conquistar novos clientes em campo — convertendo compromissos qualificados e leads quentes em novos clientes por meio de conversas confiantes e profissionais.   • Criar oportunidades por meio de prospecção proativa — usando chamadas outbound, networking e visitas proativas a instalações para manter aquisição consistente de novos clientes.   • Seguir uma execução de vendas estruturada — realizando primeiras visitas, avaliações no local, levantamentos, demonstrações, propostas e business cases para identificar oportunidades relacionadas a limpeza, segurança, conformidade e geração de valor.   • Avançar oportunidades com ritmo e disciplina — seguindo um processo de vendas consistente com próximos passos claros do primeiro contato ao fechamento.   • Construir um ritmo diário forte — planejar e gerenciar a atividade em campo diariamente para maximizar produtividade e manter alto momentum no seu território.   • Trabalhar de forma mais inteligente com ferramentas de IA/CRM e preservar padrões — usar ferramentas de IA/CRM para priorizar e qualificar leads, maximizar o tempo em campo, lidar com objeções com confiança e manter o CRM atualizado para visibilidade clara do pipeline e uma experiência profissional para o cliente.      Sobre você    Você é um desenvolvedor de novos negócios comprovado que prospera em campo, responsável por um território B2 B onde metas importam e o momentum faz diferença. Você cria oportunidades por meio de prospecção disciplinada e qualificação inteligente, construindo um pipeline que converte.    Você é credível em ambientes industriais/técnicos e confiante para conduzir o ciclo completo de vendas — primeira reunião, avaliação, proposta e fechamento — com ritmo e propósito. Você é orientado por dados, usando CRM e ferramentas de vendas modernas para priorizar atividades, gerir pipeline e prever com precisão.    Você é resiliente, de alta energia e autogerenciável, com integridade para representar a Servicekleen de forma profissional em todos os pontos de contato com o cliente.      Requisitos / Diferenciais principais   • Experiência majoritariamente em campo em vendas consultivas, com entrega consistente de metas.   • Forte geração de novos negócios e execução de vendas estruturada.   • Confiante, tenaz e orientado a resultados.   • Carteira de motorista válida (obrigatória).      A Servicekleen está comprometida em criar um local de trabalho inclusivo e é empregadora que oferece oportunidades iguais.

Gestão Técnica: Planejar e executar estudos de degradação forçada (RDC 964/2025 e Guia 04/2015), interpretando dados complexos e perfis de degradação. Validação Completa: Conduzir validações de metodologias analíticas (RDC 166/2017 e Guia 10/2017), garantindo o cumprimento estatístico e regulatório. Documentação e Revisão: Elaborar protocolos e relatórios técnicos complexos, além de auxiliar na revisão de dados brutos gerados pela equipe. Resolução de Problemas: Atuar ativamente no troubleshooting de equipamentos e métodos, propondo soluções técnicas eficientes. Interface Técnica: Participar de discussões científicas avançadas com a equipe e, eventualmente, apoiar no suporte técnico a clientes.    Para se candidatar, você precisa   Formação: Superior completo em Química ou Farmácia. Pós-graduação ou especialização na área analítica será um diferencial. Experiência: Experiência sólida e comprovada em laboratório de desenvolvimento analítico (indispensável domínio das rotinas de P&D). Domínio Técnico: Expertise em cromatografia líquida (HPLC/UHPLC) e gasosa (GC), desenvolvimento de métodos do zero e tratamento estatístico de dados. Regulatório: Profundo conhecimento das normas da ANVISA (RDC 964, RDC 166, RDC 318, etc.). Idiomas e Ferramentas: Inglês técnico (leitura avançada/escrita intermediária) e domínio do Pacote Office. Mobilidade: Disponibilidade para viagens eventuais na região da Grande São Paulo.    Por que escolher a SCIENTIA?    Oferecemos um ambiente onde sua experiência é valorizada. Aqui você terá espaço para propor inovações, liderar frentes técnicas e continuar seu desenvolvimento através de um plano de carreira estruturado , com desafios à altura da sua experiência.    Benefícios que cuidam de você   Plano de Saúde sem coparticipação ️ Seguro de Vida ️ Vale Refeição e Vale Alimentação Vale Transporte ou Vale Combustível Total Pass (saúde e bem-estar) PLR (Participação nos Lucros e Resultados)    Detalhes da Vaga   Local: Presencial em Guarulhos - SP . ⏰ Horário: Administrativo Flexível (08:00 às 17:00) - 40h semanais.
